title: Travis Walton abduction

tellings.quote: It's a very remote area of the snowflake, Arizona up in the mountains when that encounter occurred.
know, Travis Walton is another good example where he's in Arizona with his friends.
tellings.difference: Told by the host, who mentions only that Walton was with friends in Arizona.
tellings.link_reason: Both refer to the 1975 Travis Walton encounter in Arizona as a whole.

related.note: Same 1975 Travis Walton abduction, but the core claim is different: Shermer says it was made up and points to a failed lie detector test.

plain: In 1975 a man named Travis Walton is said to have been taken aboard a UFO, a story usually called an abduction, while out with friends in a very remote mountain area near Snowflake, Arizona. A UFO researcher named James Fox, who tells the case without naming a source, stresses how isolated the spot was when the encounter happened. Michels brings Walton up himself as "another good example" of an abduction, and says only that Walton was in Arizona with his friends. If true, it would be a case where a man vanished in front of friends and came back telling of being taken.
